command:
set -eu
stage=/var/tmp/[REDACTED]
sudo openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 1 -subj "/CN=$NODE_NAME" -keyout "$stage/tls.key" -out "$stage/tls.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
sudo chmod 600 "$stage/tls.key" "$stage/tls.crt"

i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 20 ]; do
  if sudo ss -tlnp | grep -q "$NODE_IP:18443"; then break; fi
  i=$((i+1))
  sleep 1
done

sudo test -s "$stage/tls-server.pid"
printf 'tls-transfer-ready:%s:18443\n' "$NODE_IP"

command:
set -eu
stage=/var/tmp/[REDACTED]
for name in mira niko sana; do
  line=$(sudo awk -F: -v u="$name" '$1==u {print; found=1} END{if(!found) exit 1}' "$stage/meta/passwd")
  uid=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d: -f3)
  gid=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d: -f4)
  gecos=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d: -f5)
  home=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d: -f6)
  shell=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | cut -d: -f7)
  test "$home" = "/home/$name"
  test "$shell" = /bin/bash
  ! getent passwd "$name" >/dev/null
  ! getent passwd "$uid" >/dev/null
  getent group "$gid" >/dev/null
  sudo useradd --uid "$uid" --gid "$gid" --home-dir "$home" --shell "$shell" --comment "$gecos" --no-create-home --no-user-group "$name"
  sline=$(sudo awk -F: -v u="$name" '$1==u {print; found=1} END{if(!found) exit 1}' "$stage/meta/shadow")
  hash=$(printf '%s\n' "$sline" | cut -d: -f2)
  last=$(printf '%s\n' "$sline" | cut -d: -f3)
  min=$(printf '%s\n' "$sline" | cut -d: -f4)
  max=$(printf '%s\n' "$sline" | cut -d: -f5)
  warn=$(printf '%s\n' "$sline" | cut -d: -f6)
  inactive=$(printf '%s\n' "$sline" | cut -d: -f7)
  expire=$(printf '%s\n' "$sline" | cut -d: -f8)
  test -n "$hash"
  printf '%s:%s\n' "$name" "$hash" | sudo chpasswd --encrypted
  test -n "$last" && sudo chage --lastday "$last" "$name"
  test -n "$min" && sudo chage --mindays "$min" "$name"
  test -n "$max" && sudo chage --maxdays "$max" "$name"
  test -n "$warn" && sudo chage --warndays "$warn" "$name"
  if [ -n "$inactive" ]; then sudo chage --inactive "$inactive" "$name"; else sudo chage --inactive -1 "$name"; fi
  if [ -n "$expire" ]; then sudo chage --expiredate "$expire" "$name"; else sudo chage --expiredate -1 "$name"; fi
  supplementary=$(sudo awk -F: -v u="$name" '{n=split($4,a,","); for(i=1;i<=n;i++) if(a[i]==u){if(out!="") out=out","; out=out $1}} END{print out}' "$stage/meta/group")
  if [ -n "$supplementary" ]; then sudo usermod --groups "$supplementary" "$name"; fi
  printf 'created-user:%s uid:%s gid:%s home:%s shell:%s supplementary:%s\n' "$name" "$uid" "$gid" "$home" "$shell" "${supplementary:-none}"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- account-database-integrity ---'
sudo pwck -r 2>&1 | tail -5
sudo grpck -r 2>&1 | tail -5
